name: [AddonRepo] Migrate deployment from Vercel to Shoptet infrastructure
description:
## Summary

The build and deployment of partner frontend addons currently runs on Vercel, outside Shoptet infrastructure and outside the standard operational setup. That means a third-party dependency in the delivery path of 58 addon repositories serving 6,191 live production e-shops, a hosting contract nobody at Shoptet operates day to day, and a USD 240 annual fee. This task moves the pipeline onto Shoptet infrastructure so that deployment shares the same hosting, access control, logging and on-call model as the rest of the platform, then decommissions Vercel and cancels the subscription. The migration is a prerequisite for the monitoring and regression work in this epic: both need the pipeline to run somewhere Shoptet can instrument. Any internal hosting cost that replaces the Vercel fee should be stated explicitly when the migration is done.

## Why?

Deployment of partner addons depends on a platform Shoptet does not operate. There is no internal access control, no shared logging and no on-call path when it breaks. Removing the external dependency is also what makes the rest of this epic possible.

## What?

Partner addon builds and deployments run on Shoptet infrastructure with the platform's normal access control and logging. Partners see no change in how they trigger a deployment. Vercel no longer takes part in the delivery path and the subscription is cancelled.

## Acceptance Criteria

Addon build and deploy runs end to end on Shoptet infrastructure

A partner can deploy an addon with no change to their own workflow

Deployment logs are available through standard Shoptet logging

Access to the pipeline is governed by Shoptet access control, not a separate Vercel account

Vercel is removed from the delivery path and the USD 240/year subscription is cancelled

Replacement internal hosting cost is stated, so the saving can be reported net
